entities.summary: The most theologically rich prophetic book (66 chapters), spanning oracles of judgment, comfort, and eschatological hope. Contains the Servant Songs (Isaiah 42, 49, 50, 53) and visions of a new heavens and new earth. Most quoted OT book in the New Testament.
